Attention mechanisms in transformers allow the model to weigh different parts of the input sequence differently, enabling it to focus on relevant information for generating the output. This is achieved through a set of scaled dot-product operations that compute attention scores for each element in the sequence, followed by a normalization step to produce context-aware representations.
